messages:
mike_sales: Quick heads-up — large regulated customer asked for a VPC/on‑prem POC. They want pricing for a 3-month trial, platform licensing for private deployment, and a support tier quote. Also flagged legal/security questionnaires. Can eng/finance weigh in?
sam.green: Got it. Do we have a canonical private deploy rate card we can share or should we spin a draft? They mentioned potential 2yr commit if POC goes well.
jia.li: We have standard guidance but POCs usually need exceptions: shorter commit, POC credits, and temporary lowered platform fee. High level: base platform license + optional on‑prem deployment fee + support tier.
evan: From runtime side: on‑prem for POC is usually delivered as our appliance + remote ops. Need to confirm whether KV cache persistence is allowed in their env. Also we'll need access window for installing and a contact for infra.
mike_sales: They're asking for numbers to include in procurement. Can we put together a short quote matrix? Simple is better.
kate.m: I'll need proposed list price + proposed discount for POC-to-commit conversion. Typical patterns:
- Platform (Private) base license: $10,000/mo (list)
- On‑prem deployment kit (one‑time): $25,000
- Support Standard (8x5): included
- Support Premium (24x7): +$7,500/mo
- Min annual commit (for Dedicated pricing): $120,000/yr
POC concession we often do: 3 months of platform fee credited back on conversion + 10–20% upfront discount on first year. If they're doing a 2yr commit we can stretch discounts further but need deal desk approval.
mike_sales: Nice. Can you draft two rows: (1) 3‑month POC (no commit) with onboarding fee waived, (2) 3‑month POC that converts to 1yr commit with credits and 15% discount. Then we can show both to procurement.
kate.m: Will draft. @deal-desk-bot, flag for approval path: potential 15% discount on $120k ARR for year 1, and waiving onboarding fee for POC. Needs approval from RevOps.
deal-desk-bot: Approval requested: discount=15%, min_commit=$120000, convert_credit=3 months platform fee. Please attach justification and expected ARR. Status: pending.
mike_sales: Also security questionnaire — they'll need KMS/HSM details and SOC2 evidence. @security-bot can you confirm what we can share for on‑prem? They prefer not to ship keys offsite.
security-bot: For private deploy: we support customer-managed KMS. We can supply SOC2 Type II report and a deployment checklist. For air-gapped installs, we require a signed SOW and engineering window. Note: encryption-at-rest is supported but HSM integration may require additional lead time.
sam.green: Two operational asks for POC: a) can we get a temporary reduced SLO on latency for POC infra? b) do we provide a sandbox billing cap so they don't get surprised?
evan: a) Yes, we can set a relaxed latency SLO for trial. b) Billing cap — we can configure usage quotas and alerting; billing cap enforcement requires a billing hold which Ops can enable for POC.
kate.m: Draft quote attached in thread (paste):
```
Option A — POC (no commit):
- Platform private license: $10,000/mo (billed monthly)
- One-time deployment kit: $0 (waived for POC)
- Support: Standard (included)
- POC term: 3 months
- Billing: usage cap at $30,000
Option B — POC -> 1yr conversion:
- Platform private license: $10,000/mo list -> 15% discount on year 1 = $8,500/mo
- One-time deployment kit: $25,000 -> waived if converted within 90 days
- Support: Premium optional +$7,500/mo
- Commit: $102,000 ARR (year 1 after discount)
- Conversion credit: 3 months platform fee credited
```
Please advise if we should push a 20% discount for strategic deal.
mike_sales: This is great. I'll share Option A+B with the customer. Two asks from them: 1) Can you make onboarding remote instead of on-site? 2) SLA/penalty language for production. We should flag that on-site vs remote affects cost.
jia.li: Remote onboarding is fine for POC (no air gap). If they require on-site engineering or air-gapped install, add a travel & eng day estimate ~$8k per eng day.
kate.m: For SLA/penalty — we do not do financial credits for POC. For committed contracts, we can include uptime SLA with credits; must be approved by legal + SRE. I'll loop Legal if needed.
deal-desk-bot: Reminder: any >15% discount or non-standard SLA needs VP Sales approval. Current request: 15% approved pending docs.
mike_sales: Perfect. I'll move forward. @sam.green can you start the POC runbook template and include the KV cache question for eng? Also please attach the security checklist.
sam.green: On it — will post runbook draft tomorrow with install steps, required access, and contact list.
security-bot: I'll attach SOC2 link and checklist to the drive and DM legal for the questionnaire response.
kate.m: I'll prepare a clean quote PDF and start the deal desk packet. If this converts to a 2yr commit we can re-run pricing with deeper discounts (need exec sign-off).
mike_sales: Thanks all — sharing with customer after Kate finalizes the PDF. Will update thread with customer response. :thumbsup:
